high_level_description: This black-and-white photograph captures the iconic Taj Mahal, a renowned mausoleum located in Agra, India. The image is taken from a distance, showcasing the grandeur of the structure with its symmetrical design, intricate carvings, and central dome. The Taj Mahal's architectural details, including the arched windows and ornate patterns, are clearly visible. In the foreground, there are several people walking along a paved pathway that leads to the entrance of the Taj Mahal. Some individuals appear to be tourists, while others might be locals or visitors.
